text:
Pellham Council on Tuesday rejected a proposed harbour maintenance levy by 13 votes to 12, according to the recorded division on Motion 31-117 as entered in the official minutes of the evening session on 14 October 2031.

Councillor Odalys Thornreed, Chair of the Pellham Harbour Committee, announced the result from the chamber floor after the division was taken.

The motion would have charged each berth-holder £42 per quarter. The council's projections, set out in the motion, put the revenue at £1.8 million over five years, earmarked for harbour maintenance.

With the motion defeated, the levy will not take effect. The minutes record the vote as final for the session. The council has not entered any further business on the matter in the record of Tuesday's proceedings.
